content: We did the following basic preprocessing to our data, 1) added `none' to the beginning of the input utterance, so the network could point to it when there was no relevant information in the input, 2) filtered outliers with a large number of grounded transcript sentences ($>$150 words), and 3) converted all text to lower case.
